# @k8ordo/ui

> React components from k8ordo, with semantic design tokens, dark mode,
> built-in wording that follows `@k8ordo/i18n` (Japanese and English included), AI chat components, and a catalog of
> these components, described for no generative-UI format in particular, that lets
> an LLM compose, check, and render on-brand UIs through json-render, OpenUI, A2UI,
> or a format of your own.
>
> Like every k8ordo package it assumes React 19 and Server Components, uses only
> what has reached Baseline newly available, and ships no polyfills or legacy
> fallbacks — so nothing here branches for a browser or a framework it does not
> support.

When installed via npm, these docs live under `node_modules/@k8ordo/ui/docs/`.
Start with GUIDE.md, then follow the reference most relevant to the task.

## Guide

- [Design Guide](GUIDE.md): setup, dark mode (the `dark` class that `@k8ordo/color-scheme` puts on `<html>`, and the `color-scheme` the stylesheet sets to match), printing (the light values come back under `@media print`; `print-as-shown` keeps the screen scheme), i18n (wording in `@k8ordo/i18n`'s current locale, English without a locale set, registering other locales), design direction, aesthetic guidelines, component usage principles, anti-patterns, implementation principles, testing (component tests belong in a real browser — Vitest browser mode or Playwright — because the components call browser APIs jsdom does not implement).

## Entry points

- `@k8ordo/ui/styles.css` — load once at the application's entry: the layer
  order, the tokens, a reset and the base styles. Each component imports its
  own CSS.
- `@k8ordo/ui/tailwind.css` — in a Tailwind CSS 4 project, imported after
  `tailwindcss` in place of `styles.css`: the same stylesheet plus utilities
  that read the tokens.
- `@k8ordo/ui/tokens.css` — the tokens and the `color-scheme` rules alone, for
  a page that reads the variables and nothing else.
- `@k8ordo/ui` — the components, `ToastProvider` and `useToast`, and the
  shared types (`Status`, `Placement`, `DialogSide`, `Option`, …).
- `@k8ordo/ui/icons` — the line icons, one module each, and `BaseIcon` for
  drawing your own.
- `@k8ordo/ui/ai` — the AI chat components; `@k8ordo/ui/ai/response` —
  `Response`, the streaming Markdown renderer (optional peer `streamdown`).
- `@k8ordo/ui/code-block` — `CodeBlock`, an async Server Component highlighted
  with shiki (optional peer `shiki`).
- `@k8ordo/ui/i18n` — `ja`, `en`, `registerMessages`, `getMessages`, and the
  `Messages` type.
- `@k8ordo/ui/catalog` — the generative-UI catalog (server-safe);
  `@k8ordo/ui/catalog/render` — how each entry is drawn (client).
- `@k8ordo/ui/tokens` and `@k8ordo/ui/props.json` — data, under Data exports
  below.

## References

- [Components](references/components.md): full component list, import paths, props, and i18n — every component, compound ones included (`Tabs.Root`, `Accordion.Item`, …), renders from a Server Component, `FormControl` with its `renderInput` included; a client part given a function other than a Server Action (`Popover.Trigger`'s `renderItem`, `DataTable`'s `getRowId`, a handler) renders from a Client Component — component wording comes from the dictionary of `@k8ordo/i18n`'s current locale (English when the app defines no locale set); `@k8ordo/ui/i18n` exports `ja` / `en` / the `Messages` type, `registerMessages(locale, messages)` for any other locale or a replacement (per-component wording props win over any dictionary), and `getMessages()` — not a hook — to read the wording in effect in your own elements.
- [AI chat](references/ai-chat.md): AI chat components from `@k8ordo/ui/ai` (Conversation / Message / PromptInput / Reasoning / Suggestion / ToolInvocation / Attachment / Source) — tool approval, attachments, sources, and message actions included, streaming Markdown `Response` from `@k8ordo/ui/ai/response` (optional peer `streamdown`), with types that take the AI SDK's own shapes and the AI SDK glue (`mapMessageParts`) to copy from `examples/ui-integrations`.
- [Generative UI](references/generative-ui.md): the catalog an LLM composes UIs from — `catalog` from `@k8ordo/ui/catalog` (server-safe: each component's description, props schema, children, and field value), `renderers` from `@k8ordo/ui/catalog/render` (client), `catalogPropIssues()` (check what a model wrote), `catalogRules`, how to connect json-render / OpenUI / A2UI by mapping over the catalog, and which exports the catalog leaves out on purpose.
- [Typography](references/typography.md): type scale and usage.
- [Color](references/color.md): semantic token system and dark mode.
- [Spacing & layout](references/spatial-design.md): spacing scale and layout patterns.
- [Interaction](references/interaction-design.md): motion and interaction guidelines.
- [Types](references/types.md): the shared types for typing component props (`Status` / `Direction` / `Placement` / `DialogSide` / `DrawerSide` / `Option`).

## Data exports

- `@k8ordo/ui/tokens`: the design tokens as data — `tokens`, a DTCG resolver document (Resolver Module 2025.10) whose set is the `:root` tokens and whose modifiers are the modes (the dark values of the colors, `prefers-contrast: more`, and its dark values).
- `@k8ordo/ui/props.json`: every component's props as JSON (`docs/props.generated.json`), generated from the types — the same data as the Props blocks in components.md — and, under `messages`, each built-in wording key with the components that draw it.
